apk_artifact.name: immortal-world-debug-apk
apk_artifact.digest_source: GitHub artifact API; archive digest, not an independently measured APK digest

verified_additions: Six deterministic persisted frontier locations and foot routes without consuming player RNG
Bounded connected branches including reachable-only expansion of disconnected custom maps
Survey discovery of adjacent destinations without movement or hidden-name leakage
Travel validated from persisted routes with exact durations, clock rollover and scheduled simulation
Actual recorded path descriptions included in provider authority facts and offline journey prose
Finite location-specific herb and ore tables preserve depletion across saves and visits
Explicit confirmed one-time expansion with no paid AI call and provider proposal rejection
Portable v4 roundtrip and strict v1/v2/v3 migrations retain character, opening, story, encounter and RNG data
Original raw v3 backup survives first overwrite; Room close/reopen and copy/import independence
Native Map survey/travel/reload and expansion confirmation flows on both APIs, including 320dp/130%-font layout
All previous AI opening, regeneration, cancellation, endpoint, encryption, save and gameplay regression suites
remaining_manual_acceptance: Physical-phone install, SAF providers, force-stop, rotation, TalkBack, IME and larger accessibility fonts
Live compatible AI provider with user-supplied credentials, network recovery and measured response latency
Physical-device Android Keystore and profile review
Live CrowLLM account access and its actual model catalog with user-owned credentials
Live opening quality based on selected premise, first-request/regeneration cancellation and lifecycle on a physical phone
Physical-phone frontier surveying/travel/resource depletion, long sessions and v4 SAF export/import; live-provider journey grounding
not_implemented: Large procedural worlds and autonomous NPC plots
Advanced sect management, group combat and arbitrary generated mechanics
Whole-site crawling or protected-site bypass (intentionally excluded)
On-device GGUF inference or native Cloudflare account configuration
Selectable higher-realm creation or independent decorative root-quality mechanics
Generated frontier NPC populations, new quest chains, advanced encounters and sect contribution/mission/leadership progression

test_boundaries.device_tests: Real Compose controls, Room persistence and encrypted preferences; controlled narrator for paid-AI lifecycle assertions
test_boundaries.provider_wire: Actual compatible adapter against MockWebServer; no live paid credentials
test_boundaries.final_hardening: Connected-component expansion, saved route description in narration facts and an additional regression test; full suite rerun
